'''Warped Fence''' is a block from vanilla ''Minecraft''. [[Matcha Flavoured]] adds a [[Stonecutter]] recipe (from <span class="explain" title="Warped Stem, Stripped Warped Stem, Warped Hyphae, Stripped Warped Hyphae">any warped stems</span>). See {{MCW|Warped Fence}} for everything else.
